title: Naz_DOTD1 - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 4 NPCs from Naz_DOTD1.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by Naz_DOTD1 (Naz_DOTD1.esp).

Install this if Naz_DOTD1.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
author: skyrimnet
